title: Extensions of Covered Rental Days: Insurer Approval, Grounds and Network Courtesy
content:
Rental Vehicle Coordination extends covered rental days only on the grounds and within the limits below.

## Clauses in force

1. An insurer pays extra days only on an extension it approves.
2. A delay extension rests on the repair order: it is on hold, or it has a decided supplement that added labor hours.
3. The days asked for a parts delay are the business days of the back-order beyond the planned repair days; for a total loss, the days to the insurer's settlement.
4. One request asks for no more than the class's most days per extension request and reaches the insurer at least the class's extension request lead hours before the current coverage end; a later request may only cover days from the date of approval.
5. Days lost to a delay the network caused (not parts, the insurer or the customer) are authorized as network delay courtesy days, paid by the network, where the class has network courtesy for its own delay, without an insurer request.
6. A customer-pay rental extends simply by keeping the car.

## Clauses no longer in force

- "The insurer's approval of the extension request is recorded." This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.
- The clause under which the days asked for a supplement delay are that supplement's labor hours divided by the repair class's labor hours per production day, rounded up to the next whole day, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.
- The clause under which every authorization moves the coverage end date by the days authorized is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.

## The repair order behind a delay extension

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Applies to | Recording a covered-day authorization for a delay |
| Condition | The repair order is on hold, or it has a decided supplement that added labor hours |
| Evidence | The status and hold reason of the insurance claim repair order |
| Authority | The system record, read before the authorization is recorded |
| Statuses the condition reads | On hold, in repair |

## Counts kept on the reservation

- Extensions counted on a reservation are its insurer-paid authorizations numbered above the initial one.
- Covered days remaining are the days authorized on the reservation less the covered days drawn at settlement, over the life of the reservation.

## Hypothetical boundary

The current coverage end falls at 10:00 on a Thursday and the class lead is 24 hours. A request that reaches the insurer at 10:00 on the Wednesday arrives exactly 24 hours before and meets clause 4; one that reaches it at 11:00 on the Wednesday is later and may only cover days from the date of approval.

superseded_clauses: The insurer's approval of the extension request is recorded.
Every authorization moves the coverage end date by the days authorized.
The days asked for a supplement delay are that supplement's supplement_labor_hours divided by the repair class's labor_hours_per_production_day, rounded up to the next whole day
